sphere_commentary.overview:
Aggregated outcome scores across all protocols suggest broadly favorable listener responses, centered around 7.0 on the 0‑10 scale, though variance differs by series.
• HEALING shows highest n (574) and lowest std, indicating consistent positive effects.
• THRIVING has elevated means but smaller samples and higher internal variance.
• TRANSFORMING exhibits the widest spread, reflecting its ascending‑arc complexity.
• Crisis DESCENT protocols deliver positive qualitative gains despite lower means.
sphere_commentary.cross_series:
HEALING, THRIVING, and TRANSFORMING series demonstrate distinct efficacy signatures aligned with design intent.
• HEALING DESCENT protocols dominate the dataset with strong, uniform scores.
• THRIVING HOLD protocols yield the highest means, especially in Focus & Clarity.
• TRANSFORMING ASCENT protocols show greatest variability and population‑specific responses.
sphere_commentary.anomalies:
Key anomalies highlight mismatches between observed scores and analytical expectations.
• X-MD-L3 shows extreme variance (std 2.38) with bimodal scores.
• T-CF-L3 has unusually high mean but developing confidence.
• H-CR-L1/L2/L3 cluster exhibit crisis‑specific response patterns not captured by raw means.
• AutoGluon predictions diverge materially from observed means for several protocols.
sphere_commentary.development_signals:
Targeted adjustments can improve protocol efficacy across listener groups.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] Signal — X-MD-L1/X-MD-L2: create L1‑L2 ASCENT variant with longer ease‑in.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] Signal — T-CF-L1/T-CF-L2: add brief DESCENT preamble before HOLD.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] Signal — H-CR-L1/L2/L3: develop crisis‑specific outcome metric.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] Signal — X-ME-L3: test reduced rhythm density.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] Signal — X-MD-L3: increase sample size via outreach.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] Signal — T-MB-L3: trial extended hold phase.
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis:
Embedding analyses reveal widespread drift and distinct clustering patterns across protocols.
• CROSS-RUN DRIFT: many protocols show cosine similarity below 0.7, indicating analytical evolution as data matured.
• CROSS-PROTOCOL SEMANTIC CLUSTERS: strong intra‑zone links (T-FC L1‑L2, H-SL L1‑L2) and isolated H-OS-L3 behavior.
• Confidence: drift evidence is robust for large‑n protocols, but small‑n clusters require caution.
